title: Kegerator Pour Count and Keg-Level Forecast
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kegerator:pour
| stats sum(volume_ml) as poured_ml, count as pours by keg
| eval keg_ml=19000, remaining_ml=keg_ml-poured_ml, pints_left=round(remaining_ml/473,1)
| sort remaining_ml
description: Counts pours from each keg and estimates the pints remaining so a keg never runs dry mid-party.
value: Nothing kills a gathering like a keg blowing unexpectedly; a running pints-left estimate tells you when to chill the next one.
implementation: Feed a flow meter on the beer line into `index=personal`; track cumulative pours and estimate remaining volume per keg.
visualization: Gauge of estimated pints remaining per keg.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how much beer has been poured and estimates how many pints are left in the keg.
